landmarks.name: Left Eye Socket
landmarks.definition: The large, roughly circular cavity on the left side of the skull that houses the eye.

landmarks.name: Right Eye Socket
landmarks.definition: The large, roughly circular cavity on the right side of the skull that houses the eye.

landmarks.name: Nasal Opening
landmarks.definition: The pear-shaped opening in the center of the face where the nose cartilage attaches.

landmarks.name: Upper Teeth Row
landmarks.definition: The curved row of teeth embedded in the upper jaw (maxilla).

landmarks.name: Lower Teeth Row
landmarks.definition: The curved row of teeth embedded in the lower jaw (mandible).

landmarks.name: Chin Point
landmarks.definition: The forward-projecting triangular prominence at the bottom center of the mandible.

landmarks.name: Cranial Dome
landmarks.definition: The large, smooth, rounded upper portion of the skull that encloses the brain.

landmarks.name: Cheekbone Arch
landmarks.definition: The bony arch that extends from the side of the face below the orbit toward the ear opening.

landmarks.name: Jaw Angle
landmarks.definition: The curved corner region where the vertical ramus of the mandible meets the horizontal body.

landmarks.name: Base Opening
landmarks.definition: The large oval opening at the base of the skull where the spinal cord connects.

landmarks.name: Midline Suture
landmarks.definition: The zigzag seam running along the top midline of the cranial vault between the parietal bones.

landmarks.name: Ear Canal Opening
landmarks.definition: The circular opening on the side of the skull leading to the internal ear structures.
